scientific_role: integrity pilot; not publication performance evidence
lineage_boundary: This pilot measures the implemented source-snapshot lineage fragment.
It does not claim record-level lineage or record-lineage overhead.
The lineageless layer is an explicit cost ablation with a pending lineage obligation, not a compliant completed execution.
timing_boundary: All four layers execute identical compiled policy-compliant SQL.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE profiling is excluded from primary latency samples.
The complete layer may verify as PARTIAL because physical DBMS execution is trusted-executor evidence rather than a cryptographic proof.
A PASS only admits implementation of the formal runner; it is not a paper performance result.
acceptance_gates: all four layer result digests agree in every paired block
both lineage-enabled layers have identical source-edge digests
every complete-layer certificate is PARTIAL with no diagnostics
all configured source artifacts and manifests pass SHA-256 verification
optimizer coefficients and support rules are not read, refit, or retuned
